 Live Updates 
 Live updates: Sixers hold a one-point lead over the Bucks at the half 
 Follow along for live updates as the Sixers look to keep rolling in Saturday's matinee against Milwaukee. 
 By Karli Cauley • 
 Published 3 hours ago • 
 Updated 52 seconds ago 
 BOOKMARKER 
 Share 
 What to Know
 Tyler Herro leads all scorers with 20 points at the half.
 Tyrese Maxey leads the way for the Sixers with 11 points, Embiid has 10 points and 9 rebounds.
 Tyrese Maxey and Dominick Barlow have both been upgraded to available.
 The Sixers opened the season series with a 127–116 win over Milwaukee on Oct. 24, fueled by Joel Embiid’s triple-double. 
 Jaylen Brown (hamstring) and Dean Wade (hamstring) have been ruled out.
 Philadelphia has won four out of their last five games, while Milwaukee is on a 12 game losing streak.
 The Sixers are 6–2 at home this season, while Milwaukee is 0–7 on the road.
 Watch Sixers-Bucks at 1:00 p.m. ET on NBC Sports Philadelphia. 
 WHY WOULD YOU JUMP?!
 View this post on Instagram 
 Fast break clinic
 View this post on Instagram 
 Embiid on pace for another triple-double vs. Bucks 
 Joel Embiid recorded his 10th career regular-season triple-double when the Sixers beat the Bucks last month. 
 At halftime, he’s on pace for another.  Embiid shrugged off a slow shooting start and posted 10 points, nine rebounds and five assists.
 Embiid appeared to dial up his aggression late in the second quarter and played with big-time force. He slammed in a powerful dunk and converted an and-one layup against Myles Turner. Embiid helped the Sixers close the half on an 8-0 run and grab a 60-59 lead. 
 Up by one at the half
 Tyler Herro leads all scorers with 20 points. Tyrese Maxey leads the way for the Sixers with 11.
 Sixers still turnover-free late in first half
 The Sixers have 14 assists and one turnover with 2:33 left in the first half against Milwaukee.
 Joel Embiid and VJ Edgecombe have four assists apiece, while LeBron James has three assists and three steals. Philadelphia trails 59-52, with a 3-for-14 start from deep hurting its offense.
